stories.headline: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered is dated for December 3 with a new campaign
stories.summary: Nightdive Studios, Eidos-Montréal and Atari confirmed that Thief: The Dark Project Remastered launches on PC on December 3. The KEX Engine remaster includes the original game, Thief Gold content and The Tarnished Mirror, a new campaign by the creators of the acclaimed Black Parade fan expansion. A significant return for a landmark PC stealth series.

stories.headline: The Division 2's Echoes of Central Park DLC is scheduled for November 3
stories.summary: Ubisoft plans to release The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park today, November 3. This paid story DLC opens Central Park and the Upper West Side for a new flashback campaign, playable solo or in co-op, with additional skills and gear. The Steam listing remained in pre-purchase status when checked, so availability has not yet been confirmed.

stories.headline: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered targets PC release today
stories.summary: Atari and Pipeworks have scheduled Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered for November 3 on Steam. The updated 2002 monster arena fighter features 12 playable kaiju, eight arenas, refreshed visuals and new online multiplayer alongside local play. Its Steam page confirmed the release date but had not yet shown user reviews.

stories.headline: ArcheAge Chronicles enters its scheduled Steam Early Access launch day
stories.summary: XLGAMES has scheduled ArcheAge Chronicles for Steam Early Access on November 3 in US Pacific time. The Unreal Engine 5 open-world action MMORPG combines combat, exploration, cooperative dungeons and PvP in Auroria. Steam was still showing pre-purchase status when checked, so the launch is not yet confirmed live.

stories.headline: Cozy solarpunk MMO Loftia is scheduled for Steam Early Access today
stories.summary: Qloud Games lists November 3 for Loftia's Steam Early Access debut. The cooperative, sustainability-themed life sim centers on farming, crafting, building homes, looking after animals and working with other players on community projects. The store page still showed Coming Soon to Early Access at the time of checking.

stories.headline: Valve Steam Frame climbs to sixth place in Steam's October VR survey
stories.summary: Valve's Steam Frame headset increased from 0.41% to 4.13% of reported VR headset usage in the October Steam Hardware Survey, placing sixth in the latest ranking. The result signals uptake after its September launch, but the survey is opt-in and does not measure total headset sales or market share.

stories.headline: Microsoft previews DirectX raytracing upgrades aimed at cutting memory use
stories.summary: Microsoft's preview of DirectX Raytracing Clustered Geometry and Partitioned TLAS could make large game scenes less expensive to update and trace. Early technical testing reported major raytracing-memory reductions, potentially helping future PC games use VRAM more efficiently. This remains a developer preview and does not imply an immediate performance gain for existing games.
